rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=1, pretrain_steps=20, n_iter=30, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_kernel=7, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, batch_size=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, outer_wall_s=1050, per_scene_s=None, seed=123, rationale=iter-9 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB: seed 42 -> 123 (per-image N2I init/noise-floor read; GENUINELY UNTRIED -- every iter 1-8 ran seed=42). OFF iter-1 base (best-PSNR config: lr 5e-3, proj_n_bf 1, img_n_bf 1, proj_sr 0.02, proj_kernel 5, proj_sy 2.0 -- the untouched warm-start-anchored baseline; proj_sy REVERTED from iter-8 s 0.5 to 2.0 so this is genuinely ONE knob vs iter-1). PER-IMAGE preserved (warm-start amortized pre-pass on 4 train patients -> generic BF-sigma init, then INDEPENDENT per-scan Adam fit on EACH L277 slice OWN half-angle measurements, GT-free; NEVER amortized; warm_start=True, grad_clip=1.0 MANDATORY). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 lr5e-3 seed42 -> SSIM 0.92477 / PSNR 34.033 / RMSE 9.938e-4 / hr 0 / 940.4s (HIGHEST raw SSIM); iter-2 proj_sr0.02->0.0005 -> SSIM 0.92473 / hr 0 (proj_sr range INERT, RETIRED); iter-3 lr5e-3->3e-4 -> SSIM 0.92142 / hr 0 (lr-down REGRESSED); iter-4 img_n_bf1->2 -> SSIM 0.89748 / hr 0 (image-domain depth REGRESSED hard); iter-5 proj_n_bf1->2 -> SSIM 0.92468 / hr 0 (proj-depth +1 mild regress); iter-6 proj_kernel5->7 -> SSIM 0.924766 / hr 0 (proj footprint flat); iter-7 proj_n_bf1->3 -> SSIM 0.925289 / PSNR 34.097 / hr 0 / 1129.1s (marginal best, proj-depth saturated); iter-8 proj_sy2.0->0.5 -> SSIM 0.924657 / PSNR 34.022 / hr 0 / 892.8s (proj spatial-sigma FLAT, falsifier fired). Best hr 0.0 throughout, best SSIM 0.9253 (iter-7). All ran seed=42. (2) LIMITER = 6-param trainable-bilateral CAPACITY CEILING on dense-view 2304-view Mayo: HIGHEST raw SSIM of any Mayo inference solver (0.925) yet PSNR sits BELOW the LD-FBP floor -> hr 0 (over-smoothing signature). Confirmed-dead proj/image shape+depth+lr knobs: proj_sr range (inert iter-2), per-scan lr-down (regressed iter-3), img_n_bf depth (regressed iter-4), proj_n_bf depth (flat-marginal iters 5/7), proj_kernel footprint (flat iter-6), proj_sy spatial-sigma (flat iter-8). (3) ONE KNOB = seed 42->123: the per-image N2I INIT/noise-floor axis is GENUINELY UNTRIED on this solver -- all 8 prior iters fixed seed=42 (campaign-state line 181 lists seed-equivalent init as a tunable, and line 205-206 documents a per-image N2I noise floor large enough that a SEED FLIP ALONE swung demo-n2i 0.5081->0.4203). Campaign precedent: two ceiling-confirmed solvers were SURPRISED on a seed read. A seed flip is the last single-knob init probe before the iter-20 ceiling-confirmation; it tests whether the hr-0 / SSIM-0.925 read is seed-robust (a true ceiling) or seed-fragile (an init artifact). seed is a pure init knob: n_iter=30, proj_n_bf=1, 214-scans, 2304-view FBP-adjoint cost ALL UNCHANGED. (4) HYPOTHESIS: a different init seed reseeds the warm-start pre-pass + per-scan Adam noise; if the bilateral ceiling is TRUE the read is seed-robust -> SSIM ~0.925 +/-0.001, hr 0 (confirms ceiling); if there is hidden init variance it could swing like demo-n2i. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM stays within 0.924-0.926 and hr stays 0 at seed=123, the hr-0 / SSIM-0.925 read is SEED-ROBUST -> the 6-param bilateral N2I CEILING is CONFIRMED on dense Mayo (every shape/depth/lr/init knob mapped-and-dead); structural-ceiling verdict FILED toward iter-20: only the U-Net N2I real-denoiser capacity clears the FBP floor here (half-view N2I info loss < full-view LD-FBP). If SSIM swings >0.926 or hr>0, seed is a live init lever and the ceiling read was an artifact. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score): seed is a pure init knob -- n_iter=30, proj_n_bf=1 (CHEAP 1-proj-layer config, NOT iter-7 s proj_n_bf=3), 214-scans, 2304-view FBP-adjoint ALL UNCHANGED. iter-1 at this exact config ran 940.4s = 15.7 min; iter-8 (same 1-proj-layer cost) ran 892.8s = 14.9 min. Expect ~900-940s = ~15-16 min, ~260s slack inside 1200s -- ZERO budget risk. val=ALL 214 L277 slices, grad_clip=1.0 MANDATORY. in-solver outer_wall_s=1050 (17.5 min) backstop GUARANTEES a recorded result even if some slices run long. (6) HARD 20-min budget; val=ALL 214 L277 slices (NOT reduced); PER-IMAGE preserved (warm_start True, grad_clip 1.0, img_sr 0.02 NOT tightened, lr/img_n_bf/proj_sr/proj_kernel/proj_n_bf/proj_sy all at iter-1 values). Do NOT return control mid-campaign. PREDICTED iter-9: SSIM ~0.925 +/-0.001 / hr 0 if ceiling is seed-robust (confirms 6-param bilateral N2I ceiling); SSIM swing >0.926 or hr>0 falsifies (seed is a live init lever).
